description: Use this when someone asks which mahadasha or antardasha they are running, their Vimshottari dasha timeline, when their next dasha begins, or when a dasha ends ("when does my Rahu dasha end", "my current dasha lord"). Returns every mahadasha with dates, and the current and next antardasha. Needs birth date, time and town.

birth_place.description: Town or city of birth, with region or country if known, e.g. "Chicago, Illinois, US" or "Pune, India".

birth_time.description: Local clock time of birth, 24-hour HH:MM, e.g. 13:35. As exact as possible (from a birth certificate).

name: current_dasha
title: Current dasha (Vimshottari)
